prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied FRONT drawing of the approved municipal patrol labor. Change ONLY its folded wall inventory on the backpack. Keep the entire robot and held wall pixel-composition/style/proportions/head/palette/neutral pose unchanged. Currently two folded wall tops are visible at each shoulder. Correct to FIVE folded walls total: viewer LEFT (robot anatomical RIGHT) must have exactly THREE separate narrow folded traffic-wall modules in a single side-by-side row, and viewer RIGHT (robot anatomical LEFT) keeps exactly TWO modules. Add the missing third module on viewer LEFT, with its own distinct top, narrow ivory face, slate edge and red reflective marking, matching the other wall modules. Do not add or remove anything else. The ONE unfolded wall in LEFT hand at viewer RIGHT stays unchanged; thus FIVE on back + ONE held = SIX total. No extra inset, no labels, preserve whole portrait and all feet/margins.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make two small component corrections to the supplied full-body FRONT drawing of the orange/ivory fire bridge transformer. Preserve exact existing head/face/helmet, body proportions, pose, colors, six wheel locations, bridge packs, hands and feet. Do not redraw or shorten the body. 1) CAB CHEST WINDSCREEN: replace the THREE main front-facing panes with exactly TWO equally wide dark teal FRONT windshield panes divided by ONE central ivory pillar, one wiper per pane. Preserve same cab outer width/height and side-window slivers, bumper, orange lamps/grille and contour. 2) TANK INVENTORY: exactly TWO fire tanks together at the robot's ANATOMICAL RIGHT REAR WAIST (viewer LEFT). Each tank ivory with a teal vertical inspection band and red cap. Remove all tank-like white/teal cylinders and red caps at viewer RIGHT (robot left), replacing only that small rear-waist cluster with a compact graphite/orange pump and hose reel case, mostly occluded by left arm/torso. No tanks elsewhere. Six road wheels remain 1 per outer hip +2 per outer shin. No other changes, no text, no insets. Same white portrait background and complete framing.
